findings.title: Edge-order competition is a reasonable measured hypothesis, not a yield conclusion
findings.detail: 856/930 prior-claimed shallow samples represent54.2459%/55.9230% of shallow painted slots, but419/474 stop at depth1. Taking those cells earlier can remove an existing other-edge lot.3718/4073 first-cell samples are unpainted, so prior claims are not the largest category across all slots. Compare net complete real lots and state, not gross recovered columns.

findings.title: Repeated-key scopes and break counts need precise semantics
findings.detail: sameEdgeSameSideNonAdjacent includes same-slot delta0 references:4/2 distinct keys here, zero genuinely nonadjacent distinct-slot keys on one edge side. Scope flags overlap. classBreaks/depthBreaks/nullBreaks count transitions after full slots, not all stops or complete run separators.

findings.title: Before/after projection is recorded as booleans, not retained snapshots
findings.detail: lotInvariant excludes membership arrays, normal axes and serialized building/economy state; it checks IDs/links/anchor/xyz/w/d/heading/class/corner/t. Before/after strings are discarded. CountsEqual/invariantEqual are source-reviewed results, not separately recomputable raw before/after evidence. Accepted R8v post-state comparison strengthens scope but does not turn R8w into a full save/world contract.

findings.title: Rank1 remains unresolved; raster repetition is not new capacity
findings.detail: 199/172 excess preferred-key references across prospective slots collapse to196/167 repeated keys, largely across edges.135/105 remain unclaimed. Actual R8v lot union is4882/5176 unique keys with no duplicates/overlaps and612/648 lots; raw repeated candidates do not imply duplicated buildings or a free yield gain.

limits: No screenshots requested or inspected. No product change, source write, live browser rerun, build, FPS/memory, API/save or gameplay test was performed by this critic.

The route changes instrumentation fields/record allocation, not the original sample/control-flow predicates. It executes during startup as well as diagnose, so timing/allocation behavior is altered and is not benchmark evidence.

Current source and instrumented SHA256 were independently reconstructed. Both replacement markers occur exactly once. This supports exact scope for this source, not future versions with changed marker placement.

Stop reasons record the first encountered break in order: missing cell, class mismatch, prior claim. A failed next key can satisfy more than one physical constraint;64/63 class-change stops are also prior-claimed. Categories are operationally exclusive, not independent causes.

Auxiliary accepted R8v saved roads/cell classes were used to reconstruct all slot key sequences and reason precedence, including junction-degree-dependent corner extensions. R8w by itself omits full painted cell metadata and road endpoint graph.

Preferred references include only the fixed preferred depth of full-depth slots; deeper extra keys and shallow-column keys are outside those repetition totals. Adjacent overlap counts can span a class break, and categories are not an allocation-area partition.
NonAdjacentRepeatedKeys193/164 means repeated keys without any adjacent pair; it includes cross-edge and same-slot cases. It is not the number of distant same-road collisions.

The two packing identities account for emitted width and quotient leftovers, not unique world-space area or counterfactual buildable lots. Short-run slots are already inside remainder counts; extension counts are slot uses, not guaranteed unique raster keys.

diagnose regenerates lots and advances allocation work; disposable pages are appropriate. No evidence of user-save modification. Current before/after equality does not certify allocator purity, object identity, serialized economy or historical import.

No source-order change is accepted. Any alternative must be assessed for net legal run/lot yield across both seeds, loss to competing roads, stable identity implications, building/economy consequences and restore behavior before product selection.

nextOwnerSafePriority.task: A disposable deterministic alternate-order comparison is justified as hypothesis testing. Retain baseline plus every alternative complete lot/owner table and net yield; inspect lost as well as gained lots and identity/building/economy consequences. Do not choose a product order merely from counts of blocked columns.
